stem: During an end-of-shift check, a pharmacist prepares for biennial renewal. Select all generally applicable Massachusetts CE rules.

choices.text: Under these facts, complete at least 20 contact hours in each calendar year of the cycle.
In this setting, include at least two contact hours of pharmacy law in each calendar year.
At this stage, no more than 15 contact hours in a calendar year may ordinarily be satisfied through home study.
On this record, carry unused hours freely into the next year.
Given the described event, unused annual continuing-education hours do not carry into the next calendar year.
